## Answer
The marketing/source feature spans UI pages (3 pages under pages/mkt/source), API routes with two differing prefixes (internal /api/mkt/source/* and external /api/external/skyz/marketing/source/*), and a single Prisma model mkt_source. Route prefix differs: internal uses 'mkt' while external uses 'marketing' in the path.

- E2 `pages/api/mkt/source/index.ts:11-73` - Internal API at /api/mkt/source supporting POST/PUT/DELETE operations with verifyHeaders middleware

- E5 `pages/api/external/skyz/marketing/source/list.ts:5-75` - External API using Prisma ORM with 'marketing' prefix instead of internal 'mkt' prefix
- E6 `pages/api/external/skyz/marketing/source/[idx].ts:5-35` - External GET endpoint for single record fetch with 404 for soft-deleted rows
- E7 `pages/mkt/source/index.tsx:12-40` - UI list page with columns for idx, category, sub_category, title, description, creator, created_at
- E8 `pages/mkt/source/form.tsx:12-80` [partial] - UI form with useState for mktSource object and handlers for input changes and createProc
